text: The Government‑Led Efforts to Increase Earthquake Insurance Penetration in China (2020–2025) aimed to address the country's earthquake protection gap through preparatory actions. These efforts included policy advocacy for a public‑private earthquake insurance mechanism, technical enablement via catastrophe modeling, and market design discussions on parametric triggers and catastrophe bonds. The initiative focused on creating a foundation for a national earthquake insurance pool and leveraging capital markets to enhance insurance penetration and disaster risk management.
